﻿modes:

  # Base Modes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  default:
    sampleString: "Sample String (Mode-default)"
    sampleInt: 100
    samplePath: "C:\\Sample\\Path\\Mode-default"

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Composite / Inherited Modes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  sample-composite:
    extends: "default"
    sampleString: "Sample String (Mode: sample-composite)"
    sampleInt: 200
    samplePath: "C:\\Sample\\Path\\Mode sample-composite"
    sampleArray: ["Mode-sample-composite"]

  # ---------------------------------------------------------
  # Highly Filtered / Specialized Modes
  # ---------------------------------------------------------

  sample-filtered:
    filters: "sample-composite"
    sampleString: "Sample String (Mode: sample-filtered)"
    sampleInt: 50
    samplePath: "C:\\Mode sample-filtered"
    sampleArray: ["Mode-sample-filtered"]
